svg.title: NovaVision: coverage-weighted valence and arousal estimates
svg.desc: The highest of seven text-classifier scores selects the leading label and its fixed valence and arousal prior. The lexicon computes mean matched-word values; nearby negation reverses matched valence. Coverage is matched content words divided by content words. For each dimension, the default estimate is w times the word value plus one minus w times the label prior, where w is the smaller of coverage and 0.8. No matches means the prior supplies the estimate. Valence ranges from minus one to one and describes pleasantness. Arousal ranges from zero to one and describes activation. The leading label selects raw prompting for neutral and affect prompting for other labels. Affect adds mood, palette, lighting, and composition. All tiers retain style and quality presets. The bundled word values are demonstrations, not empirical norms.
